scope: Selected high-count side-less enforcement-derived Kitsilano review points outside the three residential permit PDF curb bars
method: Street View panoramas were viewed along the street in both directions where available. A parked car, absence of a visible sign, or block-level meter proximity does not establish free parking on either curb side.

findings.observation: Both Dunbar directions show parked cars, but no legible parking restriction or arrow on either curb face near the block-centre point.
The selected user-contributed panorama shows cars along both curbs, but no readable parking sign; the imagery did not provide a navigable street panorama.
Parked cars are visible on both sides, but no legible restriction sign or arrow. The selected panorama is too old to support a current free-parking claim.
Westward and eastward views show parked cars, but the available sign faces do not establish a curb rule, side, and arrow extent.
The legible green sign near W 3rd is a bicycle route sign, not a parking restriction. No nearby parking sign with readable rule and arrows was found.
